info.title: Queue OpenAPI for minimax/music-3
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the minimax/music-3 queue.

x-fal-metadata.about: Generate a song from lyrics and a music description using MiniMax Music 3.

guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale
guidance_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance scale of the flow-matching stage.

num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps
num_inference_steps.description: Number of flow-matching Euler steps per 8-second denoising chunk. More steps improve quality at the cost of speed.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. If not provided, a random seed will be used.

lyrics.title: Lyrics
examples:
[verse]
Morning light filtering through the pine
Every quiet street is yours and mine
[chorus]
Softly the world begins to breathe
lyrics.description: The lyrics to sing. Structure tags such as [intro], [verse], [pre-chorus], [chorus], [post-chorus], [bridge], [instrumental], [solo] and [outro] must each be on their own line; text on the same line as a leading tag is dropped by the model's input contract.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Upper bound on the generated audio length in seconds. The model may stop earlier; the actual duration is returned in the output.

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: Genre: acoustic pop. BPM: 96. Key: C major. Warm and intimate, building gently into the chorus. Vocals: soft female lead, close and breathy, light stacked harmonies in the chorus. Arrangement: fingerpicked guitar and soft piano; brushed drums and upright bass enter in the chorus.
prompt.description: Music description: style, mood, vocals, instrumentation and arrangement. For precise control use a Structured Caption with global metadata (genre, BPM, key, emotional progression), vocal details, and a section-by-section arrangement.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The random seed used for the generation process.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: The actual duration of the generated audio in seconds (may be shorter than the requested duration).

audio.description: The generated audio file (44.1 kHz 16-bit stereo WAV).

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
